name: Build and Publish

on:

  build:

        run: go mod download

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic -race -count=1

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: go test ./... -tags=integration -coverprofile=integration.out -covermode=atomic -race -count=1

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.61.0
          args: --timeout=5m

      - name: Build operator binary
        run: go build ./cmd/thv-operator/...

      - name: Upload unit test coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: unit-coverage
          path: coverage.out

      - name: Upload integration test coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: integration-coverage
          path: integration.out

  publish:
    needs: build
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/toolhive:latest .
          docker tag ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/toolhive:latest ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/toolhive:${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Push Docker image
        run: |
          docker push ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/toolhive:latest
          docker push ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/toolhive:${{ github.ref_name }}
